title: What a Micro Market Settlement Covers Each Period
content:
Each settlement period an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement is invoiced on the basis printed against its market format. A commission basis pays the client a share of sales and invoices only the equipment lease and one-off charges; a management fee basis invoices a fixed monthly fee alongside the equipment lease.

The clause reading "a subsidy true-up basis invoices the gap between shelf sales and the cost of goods with the subsidy the client has met" is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for a product settlement invoiced on a subsidy true-up basis.

## Shelf pricing and pass-throughs

Shelf prices are set from landed product cost at the markup printed against the market format, and the card processing charge printed against the same format is passed through on employee card purchases.

The clause reading "Where sales for the period fall short of the sales guarantee printed against the market format, the shortfall share printed against that format is invoiced to the client; where sales exceed the guarantee, nothing further is invoiced and no rebate is given." is likewise **no longer in force**.

## When a settlement may be invoiced

A settlement is only invoiced while the agreement stands installing, active or suspended, read from the standing the company's records show for that agreement before the invoice is raised. No product settlement is raised at all for a suspended market.

The clause reading "a suspended market is invoiced the standby charge printed against its format in place of the equipment lease" is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for a settlement raised for a period the market stood shut.

## One-off items in the period

An unscheduled restocking visit asked for by the client carries the call-out charge printed against the market format, and scheduled visits carry nothing. A planogram change asked for inside the planogram lead days printed against the format is taken at the next scheduled refresh instead, and the client is told which date that is. Where an agreement closes part way through a settlement period, the final settlement covers the days the market was open and the equipment removal charge printed against the format is added to it.
